tests.name: explicit_instantiation_basic_json

tests.intent: Test less-than-or-equal comparisons on json values.

tests.intent: Test greater-than comparisons on json values.

tests.intent: Test greater-than-or-equal comparisons on json values.

tests.name: mixed_type_comparisons
tests.intent: Test comparisons between different json value types to verify ordering and type-fallback behavior.

tests.name: array_element_comparisons
tests.intent: Test comparisons between json arrays containing various elements.

tests.name: object_element_comparisons
tests.intent: Test comparisons between json objects containing key-value pairs.

tests.name: ordered_json_comparisons
tests.intent: Test relational operators on ordered_json specializations.

tests.name: json_sorting_in_std_map
tests.intent: Use basic_json as a key in std::map to ensure strict weak ordering via operator< works correctly.

tests.name: json_sorting_in_std_set
tests.intent: Insert multiple basic_json instances into std::set to exercise comparison operators during sorting.

tests.name: unsigned_integer_comparisons
tests.intent: Test comparisons with unsigned integer json values.

tests.name: nested_structure_comparisons
tests.intent: Test deep recursive comparisons of nested json containers.

tests.name: empty_containers_comparison
tests.intent: Test comparisons between empty arrays and empty objects.

tests.name: equality_versus_inequality_operators
tests.intent: Test standard equality and inequality alongside less-than to ensure complete operator set coherence.

tests.intent: Trigger less_general() via operator< comparing array and object types without three-way comparison.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Trigger less_general() via operator< comparing null and boolean types to fall back to type-based comparison.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Trigger less_general() via operator< on heterogeneous nested structures where types differ at the root.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Trigger less_general() using explicit comparison between binary json type and a string type.
